form.name: MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD
form.label: Set this to root password for installation (minimum 4 characters & non-alphanumeric passwords must be properly escaped). (valid only for first run)

form.name: MYSQL_DATABASE
form.label: Specify the name of a database to be created. (valid only for first run)

form.name: MYSQL_USER
form.label: This user will have superuser access to the database specified by MYSQLDATABASE (do not use root here). (valid only for first run)

form.name: MYSQL_PASSWORD
form.label: Set this to the password you want to use for you MYSQLUSER (minimum 4 characters & non-alphanumeric passwords must be properly escaped). (valid only for first run)

form.name: REMOTE_SQL
form.label: Set this to ingest sql files from an http/https endpoint (comma seperated array).

form.name: CLI_OPTS
form.label: Pass CLI options to mariadbd via mariadbd-safe. Use with caution as mariadbd option precedence is complex.
